properties.displayName: GO-PRD-SENTINEL-105 User added and removed from administrative group
properties.description: This rule is designed to detect domain/local accounts being elevated to significantly privileged groups, which could be utilised by a threat actor to exploit the administrative privilege of the groups for malicious means, and then the same account being removed from the group in order to attempt to hide the activities from KPMG Administrative personnel with the objective of obstructing any investigations into the threat actors’ activities.
properties.query:
let lookuptime = 6d;
let TriggeredUser = SecurityAlert
    | where DisplayName == "GO-PRD-SENTINEL-105 User added and removed from administrative group"
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookuptime)
    | extend A = parse_json(Entities)
    | extend AddedUserSid = tostring(parse_json(Entities)[0].Sid)
    | extend AddedByUserSid = tostring(parse_json(Entities)[3].Sid)
    | extend concatUsers = strcat(AddedUserSid, AddedByUserSid)
    | distinct concatUsers;
let WellKnownLocalSID = "S-1-5-32-544$|S-1-5-32-545$";
let WellKnownGroupSID = "S-1-5-21-[0-9]*-[0-9]*-[0-9]*-512$|S-1-5-21-[0-9]*-[0-9]*-[0-9]*-1102$|S-1-5-21-[0-9]*-[0-9]*-[0-9]*-1103$";
let UserAddEvent = SecurityEvent1
    | where TimeGenerated > ago (lookuptime)
    | where EventID in (4728, 4732, 4756)
    // 4728 - A member was added to a security-enabled global group
    // 4732 - A member was added to a security-enabled local group
    // 4756 - A member was added to a security-enabled universal group
    | where TargetSid !in ("S-1-5-32-555")
    | extend SuppressUser = strcat(MemberSid, SubjectUserSid)
    | where SuppressUser !in (TriggeredUser)
    | where not (SubjectUserName in ("FTNUIX02$", "FTNUIX11$", "FTNUIX12$", "FTNUIXPG01$") and SubjectUserSid == "S-1-5-18")
    | where TargetSid matches regex WellKnownLocalSID
        or TargetSid matches regex WellKnownGroupSID
        or (TargetSid startswith "S-1-5-" and TargetSid endswith "-519")
    | project
        AddedActivityTime =TimeGenerated,
        AddedActivityEventID=EventID,
        AddedActivity = Activity,
        AddedComputer = toupper(Computer),
        AddedGroupName = TargetUserName,
        AddedDomain = toupper(TargetDomainName),
        AddedGroupSid = TargetSid,
        AddedActivityPerformedBy= SubjectUserName,
        AddedActivityPerformedBySID = SubjectUserSid,
        MF,
        AddedUserSID = MemberSid,
        AddedAccountType = AccountType
    | extend User_Group = strcat (AddedGroupSid, AddedUserSID, AddedActivityPerformedBySID);
let UserRemovalEvent = SecurityEvent1
    | where TimeGenerated > ago (lookuptime)
    | where EventID in (4729, 4757, 4733)
    // 4729 - A member was removed from a security-enabled global group
    // 4733 - A member was removed from a security-enabled local group.
    // 4757  - A member was removed from a security-enabled universal group
    | where TargetSid !in ("S-1-5-32-555")
    | extend SuppressUser = strcat(MemberSid, SubjectUserSid)
    | where SuppressUser !in (TriggeredUser)
    | where not (SubjectUserName in ("FTNUIX02$", "FTNUIX11$", "FTNUIX12$", "FTNUIXPG01$") and SubjectUserSid == "S-1-5-18")
    | where TargetSid matches regex WellKnownLocalSID
        or TargetSid matches regex WellKnownGroupSID
        or (TargetSid startswith "S-1-5-" and TargetSid endswith "-519")
    | project
        RemovalActivityTime =TimeGenerated,
        RemovalActivityEventID=EventID,
        RemovalActivity = Activity,
        RemovalComputer = toupper(Computer),
        RemovalGroupName = TargetUserName,
        RemovalDomain = toupper(TargetDomainName),
        RemovalGroupSid = TargetSid,
        RemovalActivityPerformedBy= SubjectUserName,
        RemovalActivityPerformedBySID = SubjectUserSid,
        MF,
        RemovalUserSID = MemberSid,
        RemovalAccountType = AccountType
    | extend
        User_Group = strcat (RemovalGroupSid, RemovalUserSID, RemovalActivityPerformedBySID);
UserRemovalEvent
| join kind=inner UserAddEvent on User_Group
| extend TimeDeletion_Min = datetime_diff('minute', RemovalActivityTime, AddedActivityTime)
| extend TimeDeletion_NanoSec = datetime_diff('nanosecond', RemovalActivityTime, AddedActivityTime)
| where TimeDeletion_NanoSec <= 518400000000000
| where TimeDeletion_NanoSec > 0
| project
    AddedActivityTime,
    RemovalActivityTime,
    AddedActivityPerformedBy,
    RemovalActivityPerformedBy,
    AddedActivityPerformedBySID,
    RemovalActivityPerformedBySID,
    AddedComputer,
    RemovalComputer,
    AddedGroupName,
    RemovalGroupName,
    AddedUserSID,
    RemovalUserSID,
    AddedGroupSid,
    RemovalGroupSid,
    AddedAccountType,
    RemovalAccountType,
    TimeDeletion_Min,
    TimeDeletion_NanoSec
| project-reorder
    AddedActivityTime,
    RemovalActivityTime,
    AddedActivityPerformedBy,
    RemovalActivityPerformedBy,
    AddedActivityPerformedBySID,
    RemovalActivityPerformedBySID,
    AddedComputer,
    RemovalComputer,
    AddedGroupName,
    RemovalGroupName,
    AddedGroupSid,
    RemovalGroupSid,
    AddedUserSID,
    RemovalUserSID,
    AddedAccountType,
    RemovalAccountType,
    TimeDeletion_Min
